source.text: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC)
Must have a pathologically confirmed advanced and unresectable or metastatic solid tumor
Part 2A: HR+ and HER2- breast cancer that is locally advanced and unresectable (Stage III) or metastatic (Stage IV)
Known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
Known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
Must have a pathologically confirmed advanced and unresectable or metastatic solid tumor listed below with documented disease progression on last standard treatment.
Have adequate organ function
subjects must be refractory to, or intolerant of existing therapy(ies) known to provide clinical benefit for their condition.

Part 2B: Advanced platinum-based-chemotherapy resistant or refractory epithelial ovarian/fallopian/primary peritoneal carcinoma or clear cell ovarian cancer (defined as recurrence ≤6 months after completing platinum-based regimen) with progression on at least one platinum containing therapy

Part 2A: HR+ and HER2- breast cancer that is locally advanced and unresectable (Stage III) or metastatic (Stage IV); previously treated with ≥1 line of standard of care (SOC) including CDK4/6 inhibitor plus ET and not suitable for further ET.

Part 2B: Advanced platinum-based-chemotherapy resistant or refractory epithelial ovarian/fallopian/primary peritoneal carcinoma or clear cell ovarian cancer (defined as recurrence ≤6 months after completing platinum-based regimen) with progression on at least one platinum containing therapy and previously treated with ≤4 prior lines of systemic therapy administered for advanced/metastatic disease

Part 2C: Advanced unresectable or metastatic gastric, GEJ or esophageal adenocarcinoma with progression on at least one systemic therapy and previously treated with ≤3 prior lines of systemic therapy administered for advanced/metastatic disease
Part 2D: Advanced endometrial adenocarcinoma or uterine papillary serous carcinoma previously treated with ≤4 prior lines of systemic therapy administered for advanced/metastatic disease
Part 2E: Advanced/recurrent uterine carcinosarcoma previously treated with 1 prior platinum-based chemotherapy regimen and ≤3 prior lines of systemic therapy.
Palliative radiation therapy within 14 days or other radiation therapy within 4 weeks prior to C1D1
Active interstitial lung disease currently requiring treatment
Active interstitial lung disease currently requiring treatment
Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), active hepatitis B or C infection
Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), active hepatitis B or C infection
Clinically significant cardiovascular event within 6 months prior to start of NKT3964 treatment
History of another malignancy with exceptions
Subjects with female reproductive organs must be surgically sterile, post-menopausal, or must be willing to use highly effective method(s) of contraception
Active interstitial lung disease currently requiring treatment
